text: The benchmark suite is the cargo project benchmarks/, added on branch bench at 1e4005e and on no other branch until the branches are collapsed. Run from benchmarks/: cargo run --release -- [WHICH] [-t N] [-r N] [-s MiB] [--compare-to label=path]. Groups normal, long-n, long-repeats, protein; default 10 MiB; rows append to runs/results.tsv. A branch without it follows the same protocol by hand on a 50 MB synthetic input.
